messages:
Alex: Quick sync — Enterprise POC with FinCo just moved to LOI. They want a 6-week POC that mirrors production. Core asks: 32k context support (long threads), tool-calling to hit internal search + live pricing API, embeddings for semantic search + rerank. SLO goals: median latency ~200ms, sustained throughput ~50 RPS, EU data residency. Also need pricing + security answers. @Priya can you confirm the metric priorities?
Priya: Confirming metrics. FinCo expects production-like throughput. Budget target for POC roughly $50k/mo but they asked specifically about cost delta for 32k context models vs 8k. Procurement will want a straight monthly estimate.
Omar: Notes on model fit: 32k means we should test q4_32k-like variants or a 30B-32k quantized model. For 50 RPS with low tail latency we should plan Dedicated capacity (reserved nodes) and tune batching (likely minimize batching for single-request latency). Tool calling is supported by runtime but requires us to expose a small gateway service and whitelist endpoints.
Sarah: For success criteria + eval plan I suggest: 200 prompt templates including long convo summaries (avg ~12k tokens), short lookup queries, and multi-turn clarification flows. Rerank eval: compute MRR, recall@5, and top-1 precision on a labeled set. Add 100 hallucination/fact-check prompts. We'll need ground-truth labels from FinCo SMEs.
Judy: Security checklist: FinCo requires SOC2 + EUDR compliance, KMS integration for keys, SAML SSO, SCIM provisioning, and full vendor security questionnaire answered. Private deployment is preferred for full separation. Send the vendor security questionnaire PDF to me and I'll fill remaining items.
Alex: Proposed timeline: Week0 sign-off, Week1 infra + model provisioning, Week2 ingest KB + index embeddings, Week3 initial evals + tweak, Week4 integrate toolcall + connectors, Week5 load and lat testing, Week6 handoff and review. Is that realistic?
Omar: Realistic but add a 1-week buffer for quant config and perf tuning. Also: embeddings pipeline (batching indexing) and faiss tuning often take an extra few days. Recommendation for rerank architecture: bi-encoder embeddings for candidate retrieval (1536-d) + lightweight cross-encoder re-ranker if top-1 quality needs improvement and latency allows. Hybrid retrieval (BM25 + embeddings) looks best for long KB.
Priya: Pricing quick ballpark: Hosted with 32k context models is higher per-token (model + memory) — rough math: higher by ~2.5x vs 8k in inference cost. Dedicated reserved GPU fleet for POC estimated in the $40k-$60k/month ballpark depending on instance types and headroom. Private/on-prem will add licensing + infra ops. I'll get precise numbers after infra spec.
Sarah: Proposed success checklist to present to FinCo: 1) median latency <=200ms for 95% of queries; 2) MRR >= 0.6 on test set; 3) top-1 precision >=80% on labeled answers; 4) <1% PII leakage on 1k random prompts; 5) SSO + RBAC working; 6) KMS integration validated. Add any compliance items?
Judy: Add DPA signed, evidence of KMS key policy, successful vulnerability scan report, backup/retention policy, and network isolation diagram. Also confirm data deletion process at POC end.
Alex: Blockers I see: procurement needs a sample contract and DPA, legal needs questionnaire answered, infra needs subnet/peering for Private, and FinCo infosec may insist on on-prem evaluation. We should identify the minimal cloud configuration to demo quickly and the fallback on-prem checklist.
Omar: Model comparison plan: run A/B with 1) 7B-32k quantized (low-latency, cheaper), 2) 30B-32k (higher quality). Measure latency/throughput, token cost, and quality on our eval set. Use KV prefix caching for repeated contexts to drop compute. For rerank: run offline evaluation for MRR and live AB for final tuning.
Priya: Action items: Priya -> procurement kickoff & budget alignment; Alex -> send vendor security questionnaire to Judy; Sarah -> draft 200 eval prompts and initial labeled set request to FinCo SMEs; Omar -> spin up bench nodes and provide perf + cost numbers by EOD Thursday.
Sarah: Sample prompt examples (quick): ```user: "Summarize this 12k token chat into 3 bullets for an executive" system: "Tone: concise, no PII"``` I'll upload a larger prompt pack to the deal folder.
Alex: Good. If security + procurement are green in 3 business days we target infra provisioning next Monday. Also confirm whether FinCo prefers Dedicated in EU region vs Private.
SalesBot: Created POC record #POC-2387 and linked initial docs + contract template in CRM.
Judy: I'll start the security questionnaire now. One ask: can we provide KMS integration docs and a sample key policy? That will speed the infosec review.
Omar: I'll run two quick perf runs (7B-32k vs 30B-32k) with typical convo length distributions and report median/p95 latencies and token cost estimates by Thursday EOD.
Alex: Thanks everyone — let's regroup in 48 hours. :thumbsup:
